label: Azure infrastructure files
about: What to look for in Bicep, ARM templates, azure.yaml and Azure Functions config: roles, exposure, Key Vault, deletion, cost. Files only.
tested: One Bicep fixture (subscription-scope Owner grant, public blob access, plain HTTP, SSH from anywhere, Key Vault without soft delete, key in outputs, secrets in a default and a parameter file, Complete mode in azure.yaml), real model, 2 runs: the first reply was refused whole for command words in prose; the second passed (49 s, $0.19), 9 of 9 found in 8 items. NOT tested: ARM JSON, Azure Functions config, deployment stacks, modules in many files, a real subscription. Not reviewed by an Azure specialist.
